notes_for_editor: One page describes Wolf Point (Forest Lookouts), and it gives only a location, a patrol-lookout label and a grid code. It gives no build date, design, staffing or fate, so the story is about 75 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence will not support more. The brief's coordinates (46.07075, -115.09928) sit about 1.8 miles west of Weasel Point's listed coordinates (46.07325, -115.06251), consistent with the source. Weasel Point is on the Forest Fire Lookout Association Idaho list (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/id/) as type Camp, status Abandoned; that list has no Wolf Point entry. The brief's kind 'unknown' stays unchanged, since 'patrol lookout' does not settle whether a tower or cab stood there. Two WebSearch queries found no Wolf Point source; search-result summaries were not used. Access and the site today are unknown, so no visit facts are written.
